claim_audit.correction: CI performance depends on the task/noise; retain concrete Noh CNOT values only.
No universal CI threshold exists.
Scalar rounding has constant algorithmic form, but no concrete implementation/timing boundary supports <50 ns.
Requires a concrete precision/device/netlist and resource report.
Use squeezing-specific reductions: 31.782% at 9 dB, 58.458% at 12 dB, 67.192% at 13 dB.
Full concatenated surface-GKP finite-size threshold under finite-squeezing-only noise; not gate-level ML or single-mode project threshold.
Noh reports no implementation latency; ML/MAP is a decision rule, not one runtime.
Requires implementation-specific resources.

claim_audit.original_claim: Direct NN and RL are one category
claim_audit.correction: Direct decoder, model-free controller and model-based Feedback-GRAPE controller are distinct.
Keep concrete code/noise/threshold results only.
Wang/Yang direct decoders do not establish online adaptation; Sivak 2026 is a separately scoped controller experiment.
Concrete boundaries include 87.6 ns post-implementation core estimate and 124 ns core / 550 ns real closed loop; no class-wide range.
Resource cost depends on network, precision, code size, device and timing target.
The optimized experimental ratios are 1.14(18) and 1.14(16), i.e. about 14%, not a universal 20%.
Classical decoder-response latency is N/A; the physical protocol contains finite-duration pulses and reset.
FPGA resource columns are inapplicable to a reservoir-engineered physical protocol.
For one structured surface-GKP task the reported threshold is 0.602 versus 0.599 analog MWPM; this is not global potential.
No universal monotone-in-mode threshold statement; preserve the exact code-family/noise metric.
Generic exact CPD can be exponential, but repetition-rectangular is linear and surface-GKP structured decoding is polynomial.
No online-drift or normalized FPGA resource evidence in the source.
Only T5 core input-to-action at 27 MHz: six cycles, II 37.037 ns; source-to-action and closed-loop are null.
Route-A V5 stopped at headroom gate; no V5 adaptive formal/quantized/RTL result exists.
Concrete T5 resource counts are implementation-specific and cannot define the hybrid category.
